Surface runoff is medium, and the erosion hazard is moderate.
This complex is suited to range.
(Capability Unit VIe Dryland; Silty range site 10-14 inch precipitation zone; Windbreak Suitability Group 3M)
Thedalund-Wibaux stony loams, hilly (25 to 40 percent slopes) (THn)
This complex comprises hilly soils of the sedimentary plains. Thedalund loam and channery loam makes up 45 to 60 percent of the complex, Wibaux channery and cobbly loam 20 to 35 percent and shale outcrop 10 to 20 percent. Minor soils in valleys make up 5 to 10 percent of some map areas. The Thedalund and Wibaux soils occur in no predicable pattern on the land but the red color and the hard surface channers mark the Wibaux soils. The Thedalund and Wibaux soils in this complex have profiles similar to those described for their respective series.
The surface runoff is rapid and the erosion hazard is severe.
This complex is suited to range and game range.
(Capability Unit VIe Dryland; Thin Hilly range site 10 - 14 inch precipitation zone; Windbreak Suitability Group 4)
Thedalund-Wibaux complex, very steep (35 to 90 percent slopes) (Tho)
This complex comprises very steep soils of the sedimentary plains. The complex consists of 35 to 50 percent Thedalund stony loam, 20 to 35 percent Wibaux very stony loam and 20 to 40 percent rock outcrop. The soils occur in no predictable pattern on the land. The Thedalund soil in this complex has a profile that differs from the typical one described in the series by having 10 to 25 percent surface channers and stones. The Wibaux soil has a profile like the typical one described in the series.
Runoff is rapid, and the erosion hazard is severe.
This complex is suited to range and game range.
(Capability Unit VIIe Dryland; Thin Breaks range site 10-14 inch precipitation zone; Windbreak Suitability Group 4)
